entries.input: Let $E$ be a nonempty subset of an ordered set, $\alpha$ a lower bound of $E$ and $\beta$ an upper bound of $E$. Then $\alpha \leq \beta$.
entries.name: LowerBoundLeUpperBound
entries.binders: {S : Type*} [Preorder S] (E : Set S) (hE : E.Nonempty) (α β : S) (hα : α ∈ lowerBounds E) (hβ : β ∈ upperBounds E)
entries.witness_note: The statement quantifies over a space or a function type through implicit type binders and instance binders, which `∃` cannot close, so no witness of the checked shape exists. The hypotheses are satisfiable: `S = ℝ`, `E = {0}`, `α = β = 0`.
